sentence: The {narrator} of the novel is a ten-year-old girl.
translation: Рассказчик в романе — десятилетняя девочка.

definition: the condition of being extremely fat in a way that harms health
sentence: Childhood {obesity} has doubled in the country since 1990.
translation: Детское ожирение в стране удвоилось с 1990 года.

definition: having advantages that most people do not have
sentence: She grew up in a {privileged} family with servants and horses.
translation: Она выросла в привилегированной семье со слугами и лошадьми.

definition: the state of depending on someone or something
sentence: The region's {reliance} on one crop makes it vulnerable.
translation: Зависимость региона от одной культуры делает его уязвимым.

definition: not wanting to do something and slow to agree
sentence: I was {reluctant} to lend him money again.
translation: Мне не хотелось снова одалживать ему деньги.

definition: relating to the way you take air into your body
sentence: Smoke from the fires caused {respiratory} problems across the city.
translation: Дым от пожаров вызвал проблемы с дыханием по всему городу.

definition: the act of keeping something, or of keeping people in a company or school
sentence: Good pay improves staff {retention} more than free fruit does.
translation: Хорошая зарплата удерживает сотрудников лучше, чем бесплатные фрукты.

definition: decayed and no longer good to eat, or very bad
sentence: The apples at the bottom of the box were {rotten}.
translation: Яблоки на дне ящика были гнилые.

definition: showing that you understand and care about someone's problems
sentence: The nurse was {sympathetic} and listened to all my worries.
translation: Медсестра отнеслась с сочувствием и выслушала все мои тревоги.

definition: the system of collecting money from people and businesses for the government
sentence: High {taxation} on fuel pushed many drivers to buy smaller cars.
translation: Высокие налоги на топливо заставили многих водителей купить машины поменьше.

definition: to criticise someone or something publicly and strongly
sentence: Several newspapers rushed to {denounce} the new law.
translation: Несколько газет поспешили осудить новый закон.

definition: a person who writes computer programs
sentence: The {programmer} fixed the bug in less than an hour.
translation: Программист исправил ошибку меньше чем за час.

definition: to write something again in a different or better way
sentence: The editor asked me to {rewrite} the first chapter.
translation: Редактор попросил меня переписать первую главу.

definition: a situation where you must choose between two difficult options
sentence: I'm in a {dilemma}: a better salary or a shorter commute.
translation: Я перед дилеммой: зарплата выше или дорога короче.

definition: a skilful movement or a clever plan, or a military exercise
sentence: Parking in that tiny space was a tricky {maneuver}.
translation: Припарковаться на таком крошечном месте было непростым манёвром.

definition: the part of maths that uses letters to stand for numbers
sentence: In {algebra} we learned to solve equations with x and y.
translation: На алгебре мы научились решать уравнения с x и y.

definition: the crime of taking someone away by force, usually to demand money
sentence: Police treated the missing girl's case as a {kidnapping}.
translation: Полиция рассматривала дело пропавшей девочки как похищение.

definition: a place where beer is made
sentence: The town's old {brewery} is now a museum and a restaurant.
translation: Старая пивоварня города теперь музей и ресторан.

definition: information about a story that ruins the surprise for those who have not seen it
sentence: Don't read the reviews; they are full of {spoilers}.
translation: Не читай рецензии, они полны спойлеров.

definition: to be in charge of a formal meeting or event
sentence: The oldest judge will {preside} over the trial.
translation: Старейший судья будет председательствовать на процессе.

definition: a tall evergreen tree with sweet-smelling wood
sentence: The chest is made of {cedar}, so moths stay away from the wool.
translation: Сундук сделан из кедра, поэтому моль не трогает шерсть.

definition: an act by a large group of people to fight against their rulers
sentence: The {uprising} began in the capital and spread to every town.
translation: Восстание началось в столице и распространилось на все города.

definition: to force a foreign person to leave a country
sentence: The court ruled that the government could not {deport} the family.
translation: Суд постановил, что правительство не может выслать семью из страны.

definition: a young person who learns a trade by working for a skilled person
sentence: He started as an {apprentice} to a carpenter at fifteen.
translation: В пятнадцать лет он начал учеником у плотника.

definition: to stay somewhere longer than needed because you do not want to leave
sentence: We {lingered} at the cafe until it closed.
translation: Мы засиделись в кафе до самого закрытия.

definition: a person who lives in a small place in the country
sentence: Every {villager} came to the square for the harvest festival.
translation: Все жители деревни пришли на площадь на праздник урожая.

definition: the fact of belonging to a group with a shared culture, language or origin
sentence: The form asks for your age, gender and {ethnicity}.
translation: В анкете спрашивают возраст, пол и этническую принадлежность.

definition: to take goods or people into or out of a country secretly and illegally
sentence: They tried to {smuggle} cigarettes across the border in a milk truck.
translation: Они пытались провезти контрабандой сигареты через границу в молоковозе.

definition: a flat metal or stone sign on a wall in memory of someone
sentence: A {plaque} on the house says the poet was born here.
translation: Табличка на доме сообщает, что здесь родился поэт.

definition: an adult female chicken
sentence: The {hen} laid an egg in the corner of the garden.
translation: Курица снесла яйцо в углу сада.

definition: a plant-like living thing without leaves or flowers, such as a mushroom or mould
sentence: A grey {fungus} was growing on the damp wall of the cellar.
translation: На сырой стене подвала рос серый грибок.

definition: something done in advance to prevent harm or problems
sentence: As a {precaution}, we took a spare tyre and extra water.
translation: На всякий случай мы взяли запасное колесо и воду.

definition: an idea of what something is like, or the moment a baby starts to grow
sentence: Their {conception} of a good holiday is a beach and a book.
translation: Их представление о хорошем отпуске — пляж и книга.

definition: a living thing that lives on or inside another and feeds from it
sentence: The {parasite} spreads from dogs to people through dirty water.
translation: Паразит передаётся от собак к людям через грязную воду.

definition: to force people out of an organisation suddenly, or to get rid of something
sentence: The new leader moved quickly to {purge} the party of his rivals.
translation: Новый лидер быстро очистил партию от своих соперников.

definition: the range of colours used by an artist, or the board they are mixed on
sentence: The painter chose a {palette} of blues and greys for the sea.
translation: Художник выбрал палитру из синих и серых тонов для моря.

definition: a grey bird with a fat body that is common in cities
sentence: A {pigeon} landed on the table and stole a chip.
translation: Голубь сел на стол и стащил кусочек картошки.

definition: a large desert animal with one or two humps on its back
sentence: The {camel} can walk for days without drinking.
translation: Верблюд может идти несколько дней без воды.

definition: to become or make stronger or more extreme
sentence: The search will {intensify} as the weather gets worse.
translation: Поиски усилятся по мере ухудшения погоды.

definition: a person who believes there is no god
sentence: As an {atheist}, he still enjoys the music of the church.
translation: Будучи атеистом, он всё же любит церковную музыку.

definition: to treat a group unfairly because of race, sex or age
sentence: Employers may not {discriminate} against older workers.
translation: Работодатели не вправе дискриминировать пожилых работников.

definition: a formal written agreement, often religious or legal
sentence: The {covenant} forbids building anything higher than two floors.
translation: Соглашение запрещает строить что-либо выше двух этажей.

definition: a long flexible tube through which water flows, used in gardens or by firefighters
sentence: Use the {hose} to water the vegetables in the evening.
translation: Поливай овощи из шланга вечером.

definition: the red-brown substance that forms on iron when it is wet
sentence: The old gate was covered in {rust} and would not open.
translation: Старые ворота покрылись ржавчиной и не открывались.

definition: a small music instrument made of wood, with four strings and a bow
sentence: She has played the {violin} since she was four.
translation: Она играет на скрипке с четырёх лет.

definition: a criminal who hides from the law, especially in the past
sentence: The {outlaw} robbed the stagecoach and vanished into the hills.
translation: Разбойник ограбил дилижанс и скрылся в холмах.

definition: to laugh quietly
sentence: He began to {chuckle} as he read the cartoon.
translation: Он тихо засмеялся, читая комикс.

definition: to make someone believe something that is not true
sentence: He {deceived} everyone about where the money came from.
translation: Он всех обманул насчёт того, откуда взялись деньги.

definition: a narrow passage of water between two areas of land
sentence: Ships pass through the {strait} on their way to the Black Sea.
translation: Корабли проходят через пролив по пути в Чёрное море.

definition: to make an exact copy of something, or to repeat an experiment
sentence: Other labs failed to {replicate} the surprising result.
translation: Другим лабораториям не удалось воспроизвести удивительный результат.

definition: the list of people a company pays, or the total amount it pays them
sentence: The firm has two hundred workers on its {payroll}.
translation: В штате фирмы двести работников.

definition: a way of thinking about a subject, or a place with a good view
sentence: From the customer's {viewpoint}, the new fees are simply unfair.
translation: С точки зрения клиента, новые сборы просто несправедливы.

definition: a book of maps
sentence: The old {atlas} still shows countries that no longer exist.
translation: В старом атласе всё ещё показаны страны, которых больше нет.

definition: the use of machines to do work instead of people
sentence: {Automation} cut the number of jobs at the port by half.
translation: Автоматизация сократила число рабочих мест в порту вдвое.

definition: a feeling of great respect mixed with fear or wonder
sentence: The children stared in {awe} at the huge whale skeleton.
translation: Дети с благоговением смотрели на огромный скелет кита.

definition: soldiers who fight on horseback, or today in armoured vehicles
sentence: The {cavalry} charged across the field at dawn.
translation: Кавалерия атаковала через поле на рассвете.

definition: having bright colours, or full of interest and variety
sentence: The market is {colorful}, with piles of red peppers and yellow lemons.
translation: Рынок яркий, с горами красных перцев и жёлтых лимонов.

definition: a political system in which the state owns all property and shares it among people
sentence: Under {communism}, the factory belonged to the state.
translation: При коммунизме завод принадлежал государству.

definition: able to make decisions quickly, or settling something finally
sentence: Her {decisive} action saved the company from collapse.
translation: Её решительные действия спасли компанию от краха.

definition: made to look attractive rather than to be useful
sentence: The old fireplace is purely {decorative}; it does not work.
translation: Старый камин чисто декоративный, он не работает.

definition: final and not to be changed, or the best and most complete
sentence: The judge's ruling is {definitive}; there will be no more appeals.
translation: Решение судьи окончательное, апелляций больше не будет.

definition: time without end, or a period that feels very long
sentence: The ten minutes in the waiting room felt like an {eternity}.
translation: Десять минут в приёмной показались вечностью.

definition: the act of removing or taking something out
sentence: The {extraction} of the tooth took only a few minutes.
translation: Удаление зуба заняло всего несколько минут.

definition: containing a lot of fat
sentence: Doctors told him to avoid {fatty} food after the heart attack.
translation: После сердечного приступа врачи велели ему избегать жирной пищи.

definition: so dirty that it is unpleasant to touch
sentence: The boys came home {filthy} after playing in the mud.
translation: Мальчики пришли домой грязные после игры в грязи.

definition: a race or event in which any style is allowed, especially in swimming
sentence: She won the hundred metres {freestyle} by half a second.
translation: Она выиграла сто метров вольным стилем с отрывом в полсекунды.

definition: grandfather, used in informal speech
sentence: My {grandpa} taught me to fish on this river.
translation: Мой дедушка научил меня рыбачить на этой реке.

definition: covered with a lot of fur or growth, or frightening and risky
sentence: The spider was big, black and {hairy}.
translation: Паук был большой, чёрный и волосатый.

definition: money or property you receive from someone when they die
sentence: She used her {inheritance} to buy a small farm.
translation: Она потратила наследство на покупку маленькой фермы.

definition: saying the opposite of what you mean, or strange because unexpected
sentence: It is {ironic} that the fire station burned down.
translation: Иронично, что сгорела именно пожарная часть.

definition: the bags and cases you take with you when you travel
sentence: Your {luggage} must weigh less than twenty kilos.
translation: Ваш багаж должен весить меньше двадцати килограммов.

definition: mostly or mainly
sentence: The audience was {predominantly} young, under twenty-five.
translation: Публика была преимущественно молодой, младше двадцати пяти.

definition: belonging to a very early stage of development, or very simple
sentence: The {primitive} tools were made of bone and stone.
translation: Примитивные орудия были сделаны из кости и камня.

definition: relating to powers of the mind that cannot be explained by science
sentence: She claims to have {psychic} powers and talk to the dead.
translation: Она утверждает, что обладает экстрасенсорными способностями и говорит с мёртвыми.

definition: relating to producing babies or young
sentence: The clinic offers advice on {reproductive} health to young couples.
translation: Клиника консультирует молодые пары по вопросам репродуктивного здоровья.

definition: morally right and good, or caused by a feeling that you are right
sentence: She felt a {righteous} anger when she saw the child being hit.
translation: Она почувствовала праведный гнев, увидев, как бьют ребёнка.

definition: having a strong hot taste
sentence: The curry was so {spicy} that my eyes watered.
translation: Карри был таким острым, что у меня слезились глаза.

definition: easily holding on to what it touches, like glue or honey
sentence: The table was {sticky} from the children's juice.
translation: Стол был липкий от детского сока.

definition: enough for a particular purpose
sentence: The ice was not {sufficiently} thick to walk on.
translation: Лёд был недостаточно толстым, чтобы по нему ходить.

definition: used to say that you are glad something bad did not happen
sentence: {Thankfully}, the rain stopped just before the wedding.
translation: К счастью, дождь прекратился прямо перед свадьбой.

definition: coming after nineteen others in a series
sentence: The castle was turned into a hotel in the {twentieth} century.
translation: В двадцатом веке замок превратили в отель.

definition: not enjoyable or not friendly
sentence: There is an {unpleasant} smell coming from the fridge.
translation: Из холодильника идёт неприятный запах.

definition: not connected with something, or not of the same family
sentence: The two fires on the same night were completely {unrelated}.
translation: Два пожара в одну ночь были совершенно не связаны между собой.

definition: empty and available, used about rooms, jobs and buildings
sentence: The flat upstairs has been {vacant} since the old man died.
translation: Квартира наверху пустует с тех пор, как умер старик.

definition: the area near a particular place
sentence: There is no bank in the {vicinity} of the station.
translation: Рядом с вокзалом нет ни одного банка.

definition: a tall cupboard for clothes, or all the clothes a person owns
sentence: Hang the coats in the {wardrobe} in the hall.
translation: Повесь пальто в шкаф в прихожей.

definition: the state of being warm, or friendly and kind feelings
sentence: The {warmth} of the fire slowly brought feeling back to his hands.
translation: Тепло огня постепенно вернуло чувствительность его рукам.

definition: a situation in which someone understands something wrongly, or a small argument
sentence: There was a {misunderstanding} about the time of the meeting.
translation: Произошло недоразумение насчёт времени встречи.

definition: to collect or gain something such as support or information
sentence: The film managed to {garner} praise from even the harshest critics.
translation: Фильму удалось снискать похвалу даже самых строгих критиков.

definition: a very small copy of something, or a very small painting
sentence: The museum has a {miniature} of the whole city in the entrance hall.
translation: В музее в вестибюле стоит миниатюрная модель всего города.

definition: to become or make steady and unlikely to change
sentence: Doctors worked all night to {stabilize} the patient.
translation: Врачи всю ночь работали, чтобы стабилизировать состояние пациента.

definition: a small container that fits into a machine, holding ink, film or bullets
sentence: The printer stopped because the ink {cartridge} was empty.
translation: Принтер остановился, потому что картридж с чернилами опустел.

definition: a piece of wood, thick at one end, used to hold something in place
sentence: Put a {wedge} under the door to keep it open.
translation: Подложи клин под дверь, чтобы она оставалась открытой.

definition: not tight, or not doing work carefully enough
sentence: The rope was too {slack} to hold the boat in place.
translation: Верёвка была слишком слабо натянута, чтобы удержать лодку.

definition: a king or queen
sentence: The {monarch} opens parliament every autumn with a speech.
translation: Монарх открывает парламент каждую осень речью.

definition: a situation in which something cannot continue normally
sentence: Snow caused serious {disruption} to trains across the north.
translation: Снег вызвал серьёзные сбои в движении поездов на севере.

definition: a person who writes the words and music of songs
sentence: The {songwriter} sold her first song at nineteen.
translation: Автор песен продала свою первую песню в девятнадцать.
